name: bluerov2_local
description: This repo's own BlueROV2 (underwater) reference vehicle, booted via tools/run_sim.sh bluerov2 up. gps_spoof and ais_spoof are disabled and N/A by design for this vehicle -- established in this project's own prior investigation (docs/ROADMAP.md WO-17/WO-18): GPS doesn't reach a submerged AUV and this ArduSub build is ExternalNav-driven so FDM-relay GPS spoofing has no effect on it (the project's real underwater position-spoof attack is acoustic_spoof, not implemented in this tool yet); AIS is a surface-RF phenomenon, N/A submerged. Only c2_replay is a meaningful test here.

gps_spoof.reason: N/A for this vehicle -- see description
